title: List Telegram chats
description: List the chats the bot of the module can write to: the given chat IDs, then the chats it was added to or got a message from during the last day

token.title: Telegram bot token
token.description: Token to use before it is saved. Omit to use the saved one.

chat_ids.title: Known chat IDs
chat_ids.description: Chat IDs already saved, to show their names. Those the bot cannot see are left out.
